Spline Wrap.js

Hello.

It's a polygon script to transform polygon object along spline path.
place it into ~/Library/Application Support/Cheetah3D/scripts/Polygonobj folder.

http://www.tres-graficos.jp/blog/files/article.php?id=69

[update:20110513b] adding new paramters. 

regards.

tg_jp, Hiroto.

## #2 — tg_jp — 2011-05-13
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/7259/post-59607>

how to fix twist problem.

and, this script have a known problem.

A circle spline causes twist transform problem. To fix it, rotate circle spline object, and rotate back wrap object.

[updated] if you have this problem, change 'spline rot' parameter.

regards.

tg_jp, Hiroto.

Attachments: [ch_20110513_twistProblem.jpg](https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?attachments/14696/)
